title: 💆 A Robot That Massages Your Muscles With AI — Aescape Makes Recovery Sessions Available to Everyone!
body: 💆 A Robot That Massages Your Muscles With AI — Aescape Makes Recovery Sessions Available to Everyone!

New York health company Aescape has developed an AI-powered robotic system that delivers personalised massage sessions for muscle recovery, in an attempt to make these sessions more regular and more widely available.
The system uses a 3D body map and depth sensors to determine the user's body shape, then directs robotic arms to press on the chosen muscle groups, adjusting the session's settings live as it runs.

The idea is that the session does not depend on one person's skill or mood on a given day, but on a calculated plan repeated with the same precision every time — which could make sports recovery available in more places at a lower cost.

That does not mean the human therapist disappears: the robot carries out a precisely calculated pressure plan, while diagnosis and deciding what the body actually needs remain human work — though the line between them narrows as the robot grows smarter.
Simply put: a robotic arm that knows the map of your muscles and massages them with calculated pressure; would you lie down on a robotic massage table, or is a human therapist's touch irreplaceable?
Would you try a massage session from a robot, or do you prefer a human therapist's hands?
